result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed with no major layout breakage. The main visible defect is a meaningless '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card. Secondary gray text on white is also somewhat low in contrast. Clipped chips, carousel items, and the cut-off card at the bottom were treated as intentional features and not reported.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a '-0%' badge, which is a meaningless discount label that looks like a placeholder or data error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is zero, or show a real promotion value only when one exists.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (delivery times, delivery fees, rating count, and bottom navigation labels such as 'Search', 'Orders', and 'Profile') sits on white with relatively low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive nav icon/label colors to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
